relevant_takeaway: Current Playwright issue reports Firefox `fill()` failure on contenteditable widgets that own `beforeinput`.
Repro prevents default `beforeinput`, mutates a text node, sets selection, then `locator.fill()` fails while keyboard input works.
Minimal blank page; all editor behavior is constructed in the test.
Tests cover real keyboard typing, paste, history, image/equation operations, and helper-driven selection.
Offset-based selection helper spans child nodes, but Slate already has semantic selection helpers and stronger native/model assertions.
